title: The data economy of public proteomics: thirteen years of PRIDE — analysis code and derived data
description: Analysis code, reduced source metadata, frozen analytical observations, aggregate evidence and a pre-submission manuscript for 36,249 PRIDE deposits (2013–2025). An offline pipeline reconstructs geography, file/date classifications, manuscript analyses, figure statistics and 600-dpi figures. Historical software-version and ZIP-contained-header observations remain extraction boundaries. Source metadata and fresh archive-directory/top-level-header caches are separate release assets. See REPRODUCIBILITY.md for executed checks and limits. Code is MIT; original authored data/text/figures are CC BY 4.0, with third-party rights retained. The BioRender overview still needs a verified publication export/license.
